# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 29 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 36 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_029_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 29

**1** Jesus said: "If the flesh [сарx] came into being [шооп] because of spirit [пна], that is a marvel [шпнре].

**2** But if spirit came into being because of the body, that is a marvel [шпнре] of marvels [шпнре].

**3** But I marvel [шпнре] at how this great wealth [нмнтрммао] has made its home [маует] in this poverty [хнке]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *сарx*: flesh; *пна*: spirit — the two in relationship
- *шпнре*: wonder, marvel; the word recurs three times — cf. Saying 2 (the seeker "will marvel")
- *нмнтрммао*: wealth, riches — "great wealth"
- *хнке*: poverty — same word as Saying 3 ("you are in poverty")
- *маует*: to dwell, make one's home; the wealth of the spirit dwelling in the poverty of the flesh
- The saying explores the wonder of embodiment: that spiritual wealth inhabits material poverty
- The highest marvel is not which came first (matter from spirit or spirit from matter) but that they coexist at all
